create.name: Michael B. Beckwith
create.bio:
Michael B. Beckwith is a New Thought minister and meditation teacher who started the Agape International Spiritual Center as a small vision group in 1986; it has since grown into a large community based in Los Angeles. Agape calls itself trans-denominational and draws on New Thought alongside the wider wisdom traditions; its Sunday gatherings, held in a Los Angeles theatre and streamed around the world, bring together meditation, affirmative prayer, music and a talk. Known to his congregation simply as Rev, Beckwith dates his own path to an inner awakening in his early twenties, after which he gave himself to meditation, prayer and the study of metaphysical writing.

The heart of his teaching is Life Visioning, a guided inquiry in which students sit in stillness and ask what is trying to unfold through their lives, instead of setting goals by willpower alone. He has written about it in Life Visioning, Spiritual Liberation, The Answer Is You and 40 Day Mind Fast Soul Feast. He hosts the weekly Take Back Your Mind podcast, posts short guided meditations on YouTube, teaches courses on Commune and through Agape University, and leads a New Year meditation retreat. He was a featured teacher in the 2006 film The Secret and was named to Oprah Winfrey's SuperSoul 100 in 2016.

books.title: Life Visioning: A Transformative Process for Activating Your Unique Gifts and Highest Potential
books.author: Michael Bernard Beckwith
books.description: A practical guide to his Life Visioning method, in which readers move through stages of quiet inquiry to sense the purpose and gifts their lives are asking them to express. Includes guided practices for each stage.

books.title: Spiritual Liberation: Fulfilling Your Soul's Potential
books.author: Michael Bernard Beckwith
books.description: Sets out the core of his teaching on moving from fear and limitation towards a life led by spiritual principle. Each chapter pairs ideas with practices such as meditation, affirmative prayer and reflection.

books.title: The Answer Is You
books.author: Michael Bernard Beckwith
books.description: Written alongside his public television special, the book looks at meaning, inner growth and lasting happiness, and closes chapters with questions for journalling. Co-written with Anita Rehker.

books.title: 40 Day Mind Fast Soul Feast
books.author: Michael Bernard Beckwith
books.description: A forty-day programme of short daily readings and practices, drawing on meditation, affirmative prayer and Life Visioning. Each day invites the reader to set aside a habit of thought and take up a spiritual practice instead.

books.title: A Manifesto of Peace
books.author: Michael Bernard Beckwith
books.description: A small collection of reflections gathered from his talks, conversations, letters, meditations and prayers at Agape. Read as short daily contemplations on peace and inner freedom.

courses.title: Practical Mysticism
courses.description: An eight-day Commune course of short talks, each followed by a guided meditation, exploring inner qualities such as peace, compassion, joy, wisdom and abundance. Students practise living from these qualities in ordinary life rather than treating them as ideas.

courses.title: New Year's Meditation Retreat with Michael B. Beckwith
courses.description: A five-day residential retreat over the turn of the year at Reunion Wellness Resorts on Costa Rica's Guanacaste coast. Days centre on meditation, spiritual practice and setting intentions for the year ahead.
courses.price: From $2,500 USD per person (shared room) to $5,400 USD (single room), accommodation included

free_resources.title: Agape Sunday Services and Meditations (livestream)
free_resources.description: Agape streams its Sunday morning meditations and services, which Beckwith and the Agape ministers lead, free online. The last thirty days of recordings stay open to everyone.

free_resources.title: The Sunday Hub: weekly meditative thought and affirmation
free_resources.description: A free weekly page from Agape with a short meditative reflection, an affirmation to download and the month's theme letter from Beckwith.

Name used as on his own site and Commune ('Michael B. Beckwith'); he is also widely known as Michael Bernard Beckwith and is often styled 'Rev.' or 'Dr.' (honorary). Slug michael-b-beckwith; check against any future listing named 'Michael Bernard Beckwith'.
His site's 'Way of Living' page sells a greens supplement with immunity and gut-health claims; nothing from it is used, but owner may want to know.
Agape University's 2027 core courses are not yet listed (the 2026 ones have passed or started); the Commune course 'Meditations for Life's Challenges' was dropped (see left_out).

Free resources are Agape pages, led by him with Agape's ministers.
